#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Bounded native safetensor row ordering, shape, duplicate and finite contracts. CPU only.
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
source scripts/shell/tinylm_env.sh
PY="$(tinylm_python)"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""
exec "${PY}" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --num 101 --name P106B_Stage7n0W_dskdv2_head_cpu -- timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=20s 180s "${PY}" -B -X utf8 -m unittest -v scripts.test_p106b_dskdv2_heads
